note: Track barre (guitar-barre-chords), step 3: the full F with the root on string 6, built from the open E shape, held and released in time, then reached from C with a whole bar to move.

exercise.title: The full F barre
exercise.why: The full F is the open E shape moved up one fret with finger 1 lying across all six strings in place of the nut, so fingers 2, 3 and 4 make an E and finger 1 does the new work.

cells.text:
Press a chord box below to hear it. Fret E, but with fingers 2, 3 and 4, then slide the shape up one fret and lay finger 1 flat behind it, as the F box shows.
Pick the six strings of F one at a time, and fix only the one that buzzes.
_Stop and shake out your hand when it aches._

Press Play below to start the metronome. Strum F once on beat 1, then loosen your grip for the rest of the bar without taking your fingers off the strings.
Keep going until every string rings on beat 1.

Press Play below to start the metronome. After a bar of count-in, the lit box shows the chord to play. Strum down once on beat 1, then use the rest of the bar to move to the next chord.
If the full F comes late, keep your strumming hand going and catch the next beat 1.
